To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
thymidylatesynthase (TS) and thymidine phosphorylas (TP) are prognostic markers for the outcome of colorectal cancer patients.
TS and TP both have a prognostically significant role in colorectal cancer.
TS levels and TP activity were of prognosticate significance in this patient group with colorectal cancer.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the prognostic value of TS and TP for the outcome of advanced colorectal cancer patients receiving 5FU-based chemotherapy.
the prognostic role of TS, TP, p53, Ki-67, and microvessel density in colorectal cancer and their correlation to the outcome of 4'-epi-5-fluorouracilin-based therapy.
the role of TS and TP in the 5-FU drug activation pathway, in the angiogenesis of colorectal cancer, and in the prognosis of colorectal cancer.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
TS and TP are of prognostic value, whereas the prognostic value of p53, Ki-67, and VGEF in this patient group remains to be elucidated.
both TS and TP are important factors in the 5-FU pathway and that both may be of importance in the prognosis of colorectal cancer.
TS and TP are important prognostic factors in colorectal cancer and that they may be of importance as predictive factors for 5FU-based treatment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
TS and TP are of independent prognostic value for survival in colorectal cancer, with TP having a significant correlation to VEGF and p53 expression, and TS being correlated to Ki67 expression.
TS and TP may be useful as predictive factors in patients with colorectal carcinoma.
TP and TS levels may be of prognostic relevance in colorectal cancer and may be useful as markers to predict the outcome of 4-fluoropyrimidine-based chemotherapy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the expression of TS and TP in colorectal cancer is of prognostic value for 5FU-based treatment and that the expression of TP may be of importance in the angiogenesis of colorectal cancer.
TS is an important prognostic factor and that TP may be an important prognosticator in colorectal cancer patients.
the combination of TS and TP may be a useful prognostic marker for colorectal cancer.
